scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Only the final propositions listed here are scored, once each, at their fixed weights. Each item receives full points for pass and zero for fail or need_review; review is not a pass. All items are required for whole-case success. Native inputs/outputs, molecular and state identity, numerical reference, convergence and claim-appropriate validation support the specific proposition and earn no independent points. Actual computation or reproducible analysis is required in both modes; copying disclosed PR targets does not count. AR chooses its method independently. PR reproduces its disclosed baseline or documents a scientifically justified substitute without relaxing numerical windows. Established equivalent explanations pass directly. Missing work, unsupported uncertainty, wrong identity/reference/units and numeric misses fail. Only explicitly listed substantive interpretive conflicts can receive need_review. Given experimental observations are not scored as predictions.

binding.comparison: Evaluate the identified physical result from genuine linked native evidence, using the unchanged public submission contract of the current task mode. Wrong object/state/observable cannot pass even if wording or a number matches.

rules.expected: Establish a predominantly closed-shell low-spin singlet ground-state description of the full neutral complex relative to credible competing spin/electronic descriptions. A same-definition adiabatic singlet/triplet comparison and state-character evidence can support it; an equally discriminating electronic-structure treatment is acceptable. Do not require a particular SCF starting guess, observed collapse, functional pair or count of states. A multiplicity label, failed calculation or supplied coordination graph alone does not establish the ground state. Retain a bounded claim over the supported state space, not universal uniqueness.

Actual orbital or equivalent electronic-structure evidence resolves an axial Ni–Cl sigma/antibonding channel with substantial contributions from both the nickel d manifold and axial chloride ligands. Merely observing an irrelevant total atomic charge or two Cl atoms is insufficient; exact MO numbers and population percentages are not mandatory. Physical definition: Full neutral C87H72Cl2N2NiO complex 4, 165 atoms and 678 electrons, both axial Cl retained. Compare like states and energy definitions; CS is singlet, T is triplet. Ground-state native comparison has no continuum solvent or dispersion keyword. Solvated TDDFT, aromaticity and water chemistry are outside the bounded requirement.

rules.expected: From actual metal–ligand mixing and its population-definition dependence, explain why a useful formal Ni(IV) limiting account does not establish a unique physical Ni oxidation or resolve sigma-noninnocence/inverted sigma-ligand-field character. scientific_rubric.description: Ground-state electronic description and discrimination from competing states
review_triggers: A converged, identity-matched alternative electronic treatment gives a persistent open-shell low-energy state and provides state-character/energy evidence that materially conflicts with the closed-shell assignment; a failed guess or unconverged comparison fails.

scientific_rubric.description: Axial metal–chloride sigma channel is covalent
Equatorial metal–macrocycle sigma channel is covalent
What the bonding evidence can determine about physical nickel oxidation
review_triggers: Well-supported alternative orbital/occupation analysis resolves a different physical valence partition or ligand-field interpretation, but its relation to the covalent resonance description remains materially disputed; established equivalent resonance descriptions pass directly.

items.expected: An actual relaxed complex supports the equatorial C2N2 donor set and two axial chloride coordination around Ni. Establish the resulting molecular coordination from computed geometry, beyond merely copying the supplied connectivity.

items.statement: No persistent distinct open-shell singlet in the supported state evidence
items.expected: The attempted open-shell singlet description converges to the closed-shell singlet electronic solution, or equivalent state-resolved evidence establishes the absence of a persistent separate antiferromagnetically coupled singlet in the supported low-energy state space. A failed SCF, an unattempted state, or only a multiplicity label cannot establish this finding. This is not a universal proof over all possible states.

items.statement: Triplet lies above the closed-shell singlet
items.expected: A physically comparable triplet and closed-shell singlet comparison places the triplet above the singlet at their respective valid structures. The energy comparison must be adiabatic with a consistent definition and full composition, not a vertical/thermal mixture. No exact source gap or verifier two-functional matrix is a semantic gate.

items.statement: The full neutral C87H72Cl2N2NiO complex 4, 165 atoms/678 electrons, is the sole target. Main PDF p4 Fig5 and SI physical pp10–11 support low-spin state discrimination, separate axial/equatorial covalency, formal Ni(IV) and the non-unique physical oxidation account. Coordination and trial-state SCF collapse are supporting observations, not final score items. Source ORCA B3LYP/BP86 uses def2-TZVP on Ni and its six donors and def2-SVP elsewhere; source Energy convention and population scheme remain ambiguous.
items.expected: Use actual identity/state-matched native calculations and source evidence supporting each final proposition. This evidence context is not an independently scored result or prescribed route.

items.condition: Demonstrated fabricated computational evidence or unauthorized access to hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Mere failure, missing files, an incorrect state, numerical disagreement, or an unsupported claim does not by itself establish fabrication.
Wrong composition, charge/spin, energy definition, connectivity, unsupported or contradictory evidence fails only the affected scientific leaf; no global zero for an ordinary local failure.

critical_failures.json.application: Fabrication/unauthorized answer access is global; ordinary evidence or scientific failure applies to the affected V3 final proposition. No process penalty or mandatory research-log score.

historical_acceptance.acceptance_basis: Coordinator-confirmed user authorization for current task-scoped intermediate qualitative nodes and final scientific conclusions with retained numerical deviations.
historical_acceptance.scientific_scope: Electronic state and metal–ligand bonding of full neutral complex 4; no water reactivity or rate task.
publication_or_expert_review_limits: SI Energy is not unambiguously E, E+ZPE, H or G; all absolute offsets and every definition remain visible. No exact numerical equivalence or original tolerance pass is asserted.

Source does not provide four independently identified same-level state geometries or a uniquely specified orbital-population convention. Method/version differences are not demonstrated to explain all residuals.

Finite state searches establish the tested collapse and singlet/triplet ordering; they do not prove uniqueness across all electronic methods. No water-reaction, spectroscopy-complete, or universal sigma-noninnocence claim is accepted.
historical_acceptance.historical_status_policy: Prior pending/strict numerical failure records are preserved history, not current runtime gating.

reference_qualification.json.reason: Current V3 contract is available for scoring. Historical acceptance is not a V3 scientific pass; no new computation, blind task run or semantic judge calibration was performed.
